info.name: Trunk Flaky Tests Merge Queue API

description.content:
HTTP REST API for the Trunk platform. Covers the Flaky Tests API (query test-case state, list quarantined / unhealthy / failing tests, link external tickets) and the Merge Queue API (control the flake-aware parallel merge queue and read its metrics). All requests are authenticated with an organization API token passed in the x-api-token header and return JSON.
